subject: Re: Model mix & pricing \u00151 token volumes and budget
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: Thanks 1 quick recap & next steps (model mix + volumes)

Hi Liam & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call today 1 really enjoyed learning about BrightLayer's plans to add LLM features to the product. Quick recap and the info we need to firm up an initial pricing estimate: 

Recap (from our call):
- Primary use cases: contextual chat for support agents (customer-facing chat), embeddings for semantic search across product docs, and a small rerank job for search result quality.
- Expected go-live for pilot: Q4 2026.
- Success criteria: reduce average handle time by 20% (chat) and improve top-3 search relevance.

What we need from you to finalize a model mix-based pricing sketch: 
1) Expected daily/monthly token volumes by workload (chat, embeddings - tokens for indexing + queries, rerank). If you only have requests/sec or documents, that's fine 1 we can convert.
2) Target budget range (monthly) or target $/1M tokens for procurement planning 1 helps us recommend model & quantization trade-offs.
3) Any constraints: private instance/VPC requirement, retention/audit logs needs, or compliance items.

Suggested next steps: if you can drop numbers by EOD Friday (26 Jun), I’ll send a model-mix pricing sketch + proposal attachment for internal review. I’ll include per-model unit economics (approx $/1M tokens) for chat/embeddings/rerank and an ops recommendation (hosted vs dedicated).

Attaching a short pricing worksheet and a draft proposal template 1 fill in volumes in the sheet and I’ll update.

Thanks,

 Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), initial-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal stub)

From: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Thanks 1 quick recap & next steps (model mix + volumes)

Hi Marissa 1 thanks for the recap and the worksheet. Quick answers below (high level for now):

High-level monthly traffic (pilot, months 13):
- Chat (customer-facing, avg. 75 tokens/request outbound + 220 tokens/context per session): 150k requests/month -> ~44M tokens/month
- Embeddings (batch index + query): 1M docs to index initially (~6 tokens/tokenized per word estimate) 1 index step ~150M tokens one-time; queries: 250k queries/month @ average 120 tokens/query -> ~30M tokens/month
- Rerank (post-retrieval scoring): 250k rerank calls/month @ avg 80 tokens -> ~20M tokens/month

Ballpark monthly tokens (pilot steady-state): ~94M tokens/month (not counting index one-time cost).

Budget: Procurement wants a target of $1503250k/year for the pilot phase. That translates to approximately $12.5k320.8k/month. If you show unit economics as $/1M tokens that’d be easiest for procurement.

Constraints: we need SOC2 + VPC connectivity. Also interested in a Dedicated pool once steady-state to control latency.

Would love to see the per-model $/1M numbers so we can compare to our internal estimates.

 Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Product | BrightLayer AI
liam@brightlayer.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing 1 token volumes and budget

Thanks Liam 1 this is perfect and very actionable. Below is a draft per-model unit economics sketch based on the volumes you shared and a couple of model options. I’m including both hosted and dedicated guidance.

Assumptions (for the sketch):
- Chat workload: generative chat using a 16k-context chat model variant (higher cap for context) vs a smaller 4k variant for cost-sensitive flows.
- Embeddings: use a dense embedding model; index cost is one-time and query cost ongoing.
- Rerank: smaller decoder model or cross-encoder depending on quality/latency trade-off 1 we'll recommend cheaper rerank for pilot.

Per-model $/1M tokens (approx, list price ballpark):
- Chat (16k ctx, high-quality): $75 / 1M tokens
- Chat (4k ctx, cost-optimized): $28 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (query tokens only): $10 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (light cross-encoder path): $35 / 1M tokens

Using your steady-state token mix (~44M chat, 30M embeddings queries, 20M rerank) 1 monthly cost estimates (hosted, list):
- Chat (16k) @44M -> ~$3,300
- Embeddings @30M -> ~$300
- Rerank @20M -> ~$700
- Total/month (hosted, list) -> ~$4,300 (~$51,600/year)

If you move chat to cost-optimized (4k) for a portion of flows (we often recommend 60% cost-optimized for routine interactions, 40% high-quality for critical agent-facing flows):
- Chat blended -> (0.6*28 + 0.4*75) = $43.8 /1M tokens -> Chat cost @44M -> ~$1,930
- Total/month (mixed) -> ~$2,930 (~$35k/year)

Notes:
- These are preliminary list-price sketches and don’t include volume discounts, reserved Dedicated pricing, or system-level savings from KV caching/prefix reuse (which tend to materially reduce per-token compute for chat).
- For index-ing one-time cost (150M tokens): at embeddings list $10/1M -> ~$1,500 one-time. We can amortize in your procurement plan.

Ops recommendation: given your volume profile and SOC2/VPC requirement, Dedicated with an initial commit (36 months) will give predictable unit economics and the latency SLAs you want. We can model a committed discount that targets your procurement target of $1503250k/year.

Next steps:
- I'll work with pricing to model a committed Dedicated quote that targets your $/1M and annual budget band. Rafael 1 looping you for comment on a reasonable early-commit discount (36 month ramp). Connor 1 can you attach the dedicated pricing template?

Thanks,
 Marissa

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 13:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing 1 token volumes and budget

Thanks for the sketch, Marissa 1 looks good. A couple notes from pricing: 
- For a pilot with ~100M/mo tokens, a conservative committed discount of 20% on list gets you into the $30k3240k/year range (assuming Dedicated commit and basic caching). If BrightLayer can commit to a 6-month ramp to 100% pilot load, we can do 25% discount.
- We should propose a blended chat strategy explicitly in the proposal: 60% cost-optimized 4k chat, 40% 16k high-quality for agent escalation. Put those assumptions in the proposal table.

Connor 1 please attach the Dedicated pricing template and the commit language. Marissa 1 I think the $1503250k/yr procurement target is higher than needed for the pilot; however the customer may prefer to purchase an annual contract that covers expansion 1 we should present a 6-month pilot + annual renewal option.

Rafael
Director, Pricing | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Sharma <priya@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing 1 token volumes and budget

Marissa / Rafael / Connor 1 thanks for the quick turnaround and very clear sketch. This is in line with what procurement wanted to see (per-model $/1M and blended chat strategy).

Next asks from our side:
1) Please send a short formal pilot quote (3-month commit + ramp plan) with the 20% committed discount and the blended chat assumptions called out.
2) Include ticket SLAs for latency percentiles and SOC2 / VPC connectivity notes.

We’ll aim to get internal procurement sign-off and circle back by mid-July.

Thanks 1 Priya
Priya Sharma
VP Ops | BrightLayer AI
